Read the complete official Spanish BASE brochure rather than treating Avina’s pooled initiatives as generic grants. The scholarship portion belongs to partner universities; financing, monthly payments and maximum repayment term are not mislabelled as free grant bounds or fixed award duration.

It is the 2009 report, despite recent search indexing, and describes historical movement support rather than current applicant conditions. The history page’s cumulative MNT totals are not per-award limits. No current call, legal/sponsor rule or award schedule was recovered.

Followed focused Southern Movement Media Fund searches into Press On’s 2023 annual report. It confirms individual/collective movement-journalism support and reports 30 projects and a combined pool; neither the pool nor its average is a grant range. No application form, selection guidelines or current dated call was recovered beyond the current programme overview.
